story: John A. Minetto State Park is a public recreation area encompassing 715 acres in Connecticut, USA. It is managed by the Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection and offers facilities for picnicking, fishing, and cross-country skiing.
matters: The park is part of a flood control project initiated by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers following the completion of the Hall Meadow Brook Dam in 1962.
name: John A. Minetto State Park
